# exec

Group: Generic Local and Control Tools

Surface: direct

Source: runtime-direct

Observed: 2026-08-25

## Definition

Runs JavaScript in a fresh V8 isolate to orchestrate nested tools exposed on the tools object. Supports text, image, audio, generated-image, state store/load, notification, timers, and yield_control helpers. Input is free-form JavaScript, optionally beginning with // @exec: {"yield_time_ms": number, "max_output_tokens": number}. Unawaited promises are discarded when the isolate ends.
